summary: User-model loading overlay. Requires its stylesheet (module 1246) and, when not in SSR and #miHoYoUserModelLoading is absent, appends a div containing the HTML template from module 1248 to document.body. Exports show(text = "数据加载中") which sets #miHoYoUserModelLoadingText innerText and displays #miHoYoUserModelLoading as block, and hide() which sets display none; both are no-ops under userModelUtils.isSSR.

exports.default: loading overlay controller { show(text), hide() } for #miHoYoUserModelLoading
